# Plans that scale with your agentic AI

Auth, RBAC, and data security for agentic AI. Start free, no credit card. Scale when you are ready.

Limited-time offer: new Cloud teams get their first month free

Through 28 September 2026. No credit card to start, full features while you evaluate.

### Free

For evaluating and putting your first agents behind the firewall.

$0

Includes

- 100K gateway calls / month
- Up to 5 agents
- Policy engine, PII and DLP guardrails
- Real-time session monitoring
- Community support Start free

### Core

For small teams running agents in production every day.

$29/mo

Everything in Free, plus

- 1M gateway calls / month
- Up to 25 agents
- 30-day audit log
- Risk scoring
- Email support Start free trial

### Business

Most popular

For growing teams that need identity, access control, and scale.

$199/mo

Everything in Core, plus

- 10M gateway calls / month
- Unlimited agents and MCP servers
- RBAC and Security Center
- 90-day audit log
- Priority support + Enterprise SSO +$300/mo

SAML / OIDC single sign-on, plus a dedicated Slack or Teams support channel.

Start free trial

### Enterprise

For organizations with compliance, scale, and data-residency needs.

Custom

Everything in Business, plus

- Enterprise SSO and SCIM included
- Self-hosted, VPC or air-gapped
- Custom uptime and support SLA
- Custom data retention
- White-glove onboarding Talk to us

Every plan starts free, no credit card. Need more calls than your plan includes? Overage runs at $0.20/1K, or move up a tier. We are an early-stage startup, so pricing is still evolving and subject to change.

## Prefer to run it yourself?

Deploy SealGate in your own VPC, on-premise, or fully air-gapped. Your data never leaves your environment.

Explore self-hosting

## Free to start

Start free on Cloud, no credit card. Full features while you evaluate. Scale up when you are ready.

## Engineers talk to engineers

No support tiers. You talk to the people writing the code. Onboarding in a shared Slack or Teams channel, answered by the team that built it.

Common questions

### Is there a free plan?

Yes. Start free on Cloud, no credit card. Upgrade when you are ready.

### What is the limited-time offer?

New Cloud teams get their first month free until 28 September 2026. No credit card to start, and you keep full features while you evaluate.

### What is the difference between Business and Enterprise?

Business adds RBAC, a Security Center, a 90-day audit log, and priority support, with Enterprise SSO available as an add-on. Enterprise bundles SSO and SCIM directory sync, self-hosted, VPC or air-gapped deployment, custom data retention, white-glove onboarding, and a custom SLA.

### Can I run SealGate in my own infrastructure?

Yes. Self-hosting runs SealGate in your own VPC, on-premise, or fully air-gapped, so your data never leaves your environment. See the self-hosting page for details.

### How is SealGate priced?

Four usage-based tiers, priced by gateway calls and agents: Free at $0, Core at $29/mo, Business at $199/mo, and custom Enterprise. Every paid plan starts free, and overage runs at $0.20 per 1K calls if you go past your plan's included calls before moving up a tier.
